programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

Normally Harry's domain, Frankie doles out the wages instead, and for the first time, Kathleen receives her payment alongside the others. Seeing her paid in rations and a handful of coins highlights the vast inequalities between them, and makes everyone deeply uncomfortable.

programme.title: While the Men Are Away
programme.desc: S1 E4 She Talked! This Happened! Esther has uncovered a dead body in the freshly ploughed field and tells Gwen. They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. Given that Australia is at war with Italy, Frankie is currently an enemy of the Empire and the farm would go to Harry's insufferable brother, Des. Harry's death also meant Kathleen was at risk of being shipped away for work.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, two women embark on a crime spree across the American south-west.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: A neurologist and an old friend head to a deserted seaside town to identify a body. Strange nights and buried emotions turn a simple task into something unsettling and profound.

programme.title: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: A drama set in the days leading up to the 2008 Presidential election, and centred on a high-end Manhattan call girl meeting the challenges of her boyfriend, her clients, and her work.

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: Depressed over her failed dance career, a despondent ballerina attempts to take her own life, only to be rescued by an impoverished, once-famous stage clown. The comedian helps revive the dancer's health and prospects, and in the process recovers his own self-esteem as well. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Claire Bloom, Nigel Bruce and Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S13 E11 Mel Gibson Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Crooked House
programme.desc: When a wealthy tycoon is poisoned in his own bed, Detective Charles Hayward is invited to solve the gruesome crime. He is shocked to discover that one of the key suspects is the tycoon's beautiful granddaughter Sophia, his former lover. Hayward must keep a clear head to navigate Sophia and the rest of her hostile family in a case where nobody is above suspicion. Stars Max Irons and Stefanie Martini.

programme.title: In a Land that no Longer Exists
programme.desc: Exploring fashion in the former GDR, this film highlights iconic Sibylle magazine, state brand Exquisit, and the underground creative subculture behind East Germany's style scene.

programme.title: Marinette
programme.desc: Marinette tells the story of pioneering French female soccer star Marinette Pichon. Filmmaker Virginie Verrier's biopic traces the athlete's battle to earn her homeland's respect.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E7 Sigrid Thornton, Tom Burlinson and Brian Dennehy discuss Man from Snowy River II and their roles with Margaret and David, speaking from the film's set in Merrijig, Victoria.

programme.title: Tokyo Story
programme.desc: An elderly couple travels from the countryside to Tokyo to visit their grown children, only to find them busy and emotionally distant. As quiet disappointments surface, a family tragedy reveals the costs of modern life and changing values. A gentle, deeply moving classic.

programme.title: The Remains of the Day
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins plays a devoted English butler reflecting on a lifetime of service, lost love, and loyalty as he realizes too late the cost of his blind duty.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.title: The Whale
programme.desc: A reclusive, morbidly obese English teacher living with severe health issues attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter in a final search for redemption.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock and George Clooney star in Gravity, a thriller where two astronauts are stranded in space after their shuttle is destroyed. Running out of oxygen, they must fight to survive.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: The story of best-selling author, Paul Sheldon, who is on his way back home after finishing his latest novel. Meet Annie Wilkes, Paul's self-proclaimed number one fan, who takes it upon herself to nurse him back to health. After reading through one of his manuscripts, however, all hell breaks loose and nothing is ever the same again. Stars James Caan and Kathy Bates.

programme.title: The Longest Week
programme.desc: Left broke and homeless by his wealthy parents' divorce, a young man moves in with an old friend and finally meets the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: Mass
programme.desc: Two couples meet for a painful and raw conversation in the aftermath of a violent tragedy. Directed and written by Fran Kranz, starring Jason Issacs, Martha Plimpton, Ann Dowd.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E10 Margaret and David review Good Morning Vietnam, Someone to Watch Over Me, White Mischief, Backstage and The Woo Woo Kid, cover the Oscars and upcoming national film releases.

When they discover a cave with ancient drawings on the walls - of thoriphants similar to them but standing upright - they embark on a dangerous journey to find the fabled city of Uprights.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff

programme.title: Oliver's Universe
programme.desc: The year 1985. Oliver, a young boy with an extremely colourful imagination, moves to the southernmost tip of Europe with his family, right when Halley's Comet is due to pass.These events will represent a before and after in Oliver's emotional life, as he searches in the stars for answers to his problems at his new school, in his new neighbourhood and at home. To top things off, his granddad, whose nickname is 'the nut job', encourages him to interpret the comet's message and take a step forwards into his new universe.

programme.title: Discovering Film

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: Dean Spanley
programme.desc: England, 1904. Gentleman Henslowe Fisk struggles to cope with his father's aloofness after the loss of the old man's wife and elder son. Then Henslowe becomes convinced that Dean Spanley, an affable local cleric with a taste for expensive wine, is the reincarnation of his father's childhood dog.

programme.title: Anton Chekhov 1890
programme.desc: Anton Chekhov, a humble Russian doctor, writes novels he sells to newspapers to feed his family. As his talent gets noticed by his peers, Chekhov even gains Tolstoy's admiration. But when his brother dies from tuberculosis, Chekhov, remorseful, decides to flee his escalading notoriety and travels to the penal colony of the Sakhalin Island, in Siberia, to write about the depraved society the convicts live in. This journey will inspire some of his most brilliant and famous pieces.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: On a train headed for England a group of travellers is delayed by an avalanche. Holed up in a hotel in a fictional European country, young Iris (Margaret Lockwood) befriends elderly Miss Froy (Dame May Whitty). When the train resumes, Iris suffers a bout of unconsciousness and wakes to find the old woman has disappeared. The other passengers ominously deny Miss Froy ever existed, so Iris begins to investigate with another traveller (Michael Redgrave) and, as the pair sleuth, romantic sparks fly.

programme.title: The Great Gatsby

Anh travels north to the capital of Hanoi, where he samples produce from the Old Quarter's 36 specialist streets then enjoys the old-world French influence at the historic Metropole Hotel. Next he visits the mausoleum of Ho Chi Minh. Known as Uncle Ho to millions of Vietnamese, he is regarded as the father of modern, independent Vietnam. The spectacular scenery of the Red River Delta around Nin Binh is the setting for a hands-versus-feet rowing race on the river. Anh goes hunting for snails, a local delicacy, then cooks them up in the traditional way. programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. programme.title: While the Men Are Away

They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. Given that Australia is at war with Italy, Frankie is currently an enemy of the Empire and the farm would go to Harry's insufferable brother, Des. Harry's death also meant Kathleen was at risk of being shipped away for work.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, two women embark on a crime spree across the American south-west.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: A neurologist and an old friend head to a deserted seaside town to identify a body. Strange nights and buried emotions turn a simple task into something unsettling and profound.

programme.title: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: A drama set in the days leading up to the 2008 Presidential election, and centred on a high-end Manhattan call girl meeting the challenges of her boyfriend, her clients, and her work.

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: Depressed over her failed dance career, a despondent ballerina attempts to take her own life, only to be rescued by an impoverished, once-famous stage clown. The comedian helps revive the dancer's health and prospects, and in the process recovers his own self-esteem as well. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Claire Bloom, Nigel Bruce and Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S13 E11 Mel Gibson Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Crooked House
programme.desc: When a wealthy tycoon is poisoned in his own bed, Detective Charles Hayward is invited to solve the gruesome crime. He is shocked to discover that one of the key suspects is the tycoon's beautiful granddaughter Sophia, his former lover. Hayward must keep a clear head to navigate Sophia and the rest of her hostile family in a case where nobody is above suspicion. Stars Max Irons and Stefanie Martini.

programme.title: In a Land that no Longer Exists
programme.desc: Exploring fashion in the former GDR, this film highlights iconic Sibylle magazine, state brand Exquisit, and the underground creative subculture behind East Germany's style scene.

programme.title: Marinette
programme.desc: Marinette tells the story of pioneering French female soccer star Marinette Pichon. Filmmaker Virginie Verrier's biopic traces the athlete's battle to earn her homeland's respect.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E7 Sigrid Thornton, Tom Burlinson and Brian Dennehy discuss Man from Snowy River II and their roles with Margaret and David, speaking from the film's set in Merrijig, Victoria.

programme.title: Tokyo Story
programme.desc: An elderly couple travels from the countryside to Tokyo to visit their grown children, only to find them busy and emotionally distant. As quiet disappointments surface, a family tragedy reveals the costs of modern life and changing values. A gentle, deeply moving classic.

programme.title: The Remains of the Day
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins plays a devoted English butler reflecting on a lifetime of service, lost love, and loyalty as he realizes too late the cost of his blind duty.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.title: The Whale
programme.desc: A reclusive, morbidly obese English teacher living with severe health issues attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter in a final search for redemption.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock and George Clooney star in Gravity, a thriller where two astronauts are stranded in space after their shuttle is destroyed. Running out of oxygen, they must fight to survive.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: The story of best-selling author, Paul Sheldon, who is on his way back home after finishing his latest novel. Meet Annie Wilkes, Paul's self-proclaimed number one fan, who takes it upon herself to nurse him back to health. After reading through one of his manuscripts, however, all hell breaks loose and nothing is ever the same again. Stars James Caan and Kathy Bates.

programme.title: The Longest Week
programme.desc: Left broke and homeless by his wealthy parents' divorce, a young man moves in with an old friend and finally meets the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: The Movie Show

programme.title: Alcarras
programme.desc: The Sole family has spent every summer harvesting peaches from their orchard in Alcarras, Spain. This year, they face eviction as new plans threaten the land. The family must confront an uncertain future, risking more than just their home.

programme.title: Mass
programme.desc: Two couples meet for a painful and raw conversation in the aftermath of a violent tragedy. Directed and written by Fran Kranz, starring Jason Issacs, Martha Plimpton, Ann Dowd.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E10 Margaret and David review Good Morning Vietnam, Someone to Watch Over Me, White Mischief, Backstage and The Woo Woo Kid, cover the Oscars and upcoming national film releases.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: Dean Spanley
programme.desc: England, 1904. Gentleman Henslowe Fisk struggles to cope with his father's aloofness after the loss of the old man's wife and elder son. Then Henslowe becomes convinced that Dean Spanley, an affable local cleric with a taste for expensive wine, is the reincarnation of his father's childhood dog.

programme.title: Robot Dreams
programme.desc: In 1980s New York, a lonely dog builds a robot companion, but after they're separated, both must navigate friendship, loss, and the passage of time in this wordless, bittersweet tale.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: The story of William Wallace, a bold Scotsman who used the steel of his blade and the fire of his intellect to rally his countrymen against the tyranny of England's King Edward in the 13th century.

programme.desc: In the well-to-do suburbs of a small town in France, a group of pretty average, well-adjusted teenagers push the limits of their sexuality until the nature of their activities is revealed. Directed by Eva Husson, stars Finnegan Oldfield and Marilyn Lima.

Stars Emma Thompson, Phyllida Law and Gary Hollywood.

Crashing through the bedroom wardrobe of 11-year-old Craig Warnock and taking him along with them for the ride, they find themselves involved in a series of eccentric encounters with famous historical figures, among them Napoleon, Robin Hood, and ancient Greece ruler Agamemnon.

programme.title: Mosley
programme.desc: After many years of servitude on an isolated farm owned by Simon, a sullen and mean-spirited farmer, Mosley and his family of four-legged thoriphants decide to rebel. When they discover a cave with ancient drawings on the walls - of thoriphants similar to them but standing upright - they embark on a dangerous journey to find the fabled city of Uprights.

When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.title: Oliver's Universe
programme.desc: The year 1985. Oliver, a young boy with an extremely colourful imagination, moves to the southernmost tip of Europe with his family, right when Halley's Comet is due to pass.These events will represent a before and after in Oliver's emotional life, as he searches in the stars for answers to his problems at his new school, in his new neighbourhood and at home. To top things off, his granddad, whose nickname is 'the nut job', encourages him to interpret the comet's message and take a step forwards into his new universe.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S13 E1 Tom Hanks Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: Dean Spanley
programme.desc: England, 1904. Gentleman Henslowe Fisk struggles to cope with his father's aloofness after the loss of the old man's wife and elder son. Then Henslowe becomes convinced that Dean Spanley, an affable local cleric with a taste for expensive wine, is the reincarnation of his father's childhood dog.

programme.title: Anton Chekhov 1890
programme.desc: Anton Chekhov, a humble Russian doctor, writes novels he sells to newspapers to feed his family. As his talent gets noticed by his peers, Chekhov even gains Tolstoy's admiration. But when his brother dies from tuberculosis, Chekhov, remorseful, decides to flee his escalading notoriety and travels to the penal colony of the Sakhalin Island, in Siberia, to write about the depraved society the convicts live in. This journey will inspire some of his most brilliant and famous pieces.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: On a train headed for England a group of travellers is delayed by an avalanche. Holed up in a hotel in a fictional European country, young Iris (Margaret Lockwood) befriends elderly Miss Froy (Dame May Whitty). When the train resumes, Iris suffers a bout of unconsciousness and wakes to find the old woman has disappeared. The other passengers ominously deny Miss Froy ever existed, so Iris begins to investigate with another traveller (Michael Redgrave) and, as the pair sleuth, romantic sparks fly.

programme.title: The Great Gatsby
programme.desc: Nick Carraway, drawn into the glittering world of 1920s New York, becomes fascinated by his mysterious, wealthy neighbour Jay Gatsby, whose lavish parties mask his obsessive love for Daisy Buchanan. As secrets unravel, ambition, illusion, and desire collide, leading to betrayal and tragedy in this tale of the American Dream.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food
programme.desc: S1 E10 Khanh Ong sets up camp on the magnificent Mornington Peninsula to cook a three course meal inspired by his travels.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: S2 E15 Rick visits his favourite local fish market at Looe in Cornwall, and he cooks John Dory with potatoes and mushrooms. In Northumberland, Rick cooks up pancakes with cheese, spinach, and ham. Rick looks back over some of the local heroes he has discovered during the series, and there is a special tribute to his dog Chalky.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits of the Sea
programme.desc: S1 E1 Fish of North Cornwall It's the start of spring in Cornwall, and Rick Stein's Seafood Restaurant is busier than ever. Rick is preparing his version of a seafood paella with squid, monkfish and lobster.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me: The Professionals
programme.desc: S1 Today's brand new Come Dine With Me Professionals heads to Cardiff where Mexican taco restaurant, La Pantera get the competition going with co-owner Sam and head chef Gary dishing up a mixture of mackerel and Welsh lamb in their trademark tacos.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Japan Bitesize
programme.desc: S1 E4 Mie and Aichi Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Japan, from its frozen north to cherry-blossomed mainland and tropical sun-soaked south.

programme.title: The Cook Up with Adam Liaw
programme.desc: S7 E74 Super Star Bakes It's like the Taylor Swift of cake! Adam is joined by bakers Natalie Paull and Gabriela Oporto to showcase their finest super star bakes.

programme.title: The Cook and the Chef
programme.desc: S3 E27 Cauliflower and Passionfruit Working at the hotel often keeps Simon busy late into the evening, so he's not known for his love of early mornings. But this time, he's made the effort to get up well before the crack of dawn to meet his fruit and veg supplier, Chris Abbot, at the Adelaide Produce Markets.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: S6 E2 Sjuharad: Gastronomy With Closeness To Nature Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses.

programme.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
programme.desc: S1 E7 Fresh from the Lagoon Sophie meets a mussel farmer on the lagoon at Taranto. At home she prepares a mussel, potato and rice gratin and cooks an octopus stew for her guests at the trulli.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Spain
programme.desc: S1 E3 Rick is invited to a beautiful beach party at La Pelosa, where everyone gets stuck into preparing lunch. Continuing his journey through the spectacular countryside, far removed from the high-rise holiday destinations of the Costa Brava, he seeks out an old mill, El Moli, a restaurant and a magical place his boyhood friend Mark told him about years ago.

programme.title: Strait to the Plate
programme.desc: S2 E4 Boigu Aaron arrives on the Island of Boigu, a place with a rich history of fierce warriors and dugong hunters, and the most western island in the Torres Strait.

programme.title: Sara's Istanbul Delights
programme.desc: S1 E4 Yellow Istanbul attracts chefs from all over the world and tonight Sara meets some of the best! Then back in her own kitchen, Sara is inspired to cook a yellow bulgur salad.

programme.title: Taste of Australia with Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: S7 E1 Coff Coast Hayden Quinn kicks off the season on the Coffs Coast, where coastal beauty meets rich farmland. He gets in a surf, enjoys some blueberries, learns to make cheese and discovers why this region is a gem.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: S7 E9 Cultured Comforts It is all about stress-free cooking for a holiday celebration. Lidia makes marinated mushrooms, vin brule, an Italian version of mulled wine and turkey breast with apricots.

programme.title: Nadiya's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E2 Louisiana Nadiya Hussain has always been fascinated by America, home to more immigrants than any other country, and with some of the most vibrant food on the planet.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, two women embark on a crime spree across the American south-west.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: A neurologist and an old friend head to a deserted seaside town to identify a body. Strange nights and buried emotions turn a simple task into something unsettling and profound.

programme.title: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: A drama set in the days leading up to the 2008 Presidential election, and centred on a high-end Manhattan call girl meeting the challenges of her boyfriend, her clients, and her work.

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: Depressed over her failed dance career, a despondent ballerina attempts to take her own life, only to be rescued by an impoverished, once-famous stage clown. The comedian helps revive the dancer's health and prospects, and in the process recovers his own self-esteem as well. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Claire Bloom, Nigel Bruce and Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S13 E11 Mel Gibson Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Crooked House
programme.desc: When a wealthy tycoon is poisoned in his own bed, Detective Charles Hayward is invited to solve the gruesome crime. He is shocked to discover that one of the key suspects is the tycoon's beautiful granddaughter Sophia, his former lover. Hayward must keep a clear head to navigate Sophia and the rest of her hostile family in a case where nobody is above suspicion. Stars Max Irons and Stefanie Martini.

programme.title: In a Land that no Longer Exists
programme.desc: Exploring fashion in the former GDR, this film highlights iconic Sibylle magazine, state brand Exquisit, and the underground creative subculture behind East Germany's style scene.

programme.title: Marinette
programme.desc: Marinette tells the story of pioneering French female soccer star Marinette Pichon. Filmmaker Virginie Verrier's biopic traces the athlete's battle to earn her homeland's respect.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E7 Sigrid Thornton, Tom Burlinson and Brian Dennehy discuss Man from Snowy River II and their roles with Margaret and David, speaking from the film's set in Merrijig, Victoria.

programme.title: Tokyo Story
programme.desc: An elderly couple travels from the countryside to Tokyo to visit their grown children, only to find them busy and emotionally distant. As quiet disappointments surface, a family tragedy reveals the costs of modern life and changing values. A gentle, deeply moving classic.

programme.title: The Remains of the Day
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins plays a devoted English butler reflecting on a lifetime of service, lost love, and loyalty as he realizes too late the cost of his blind duty.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.title: The Whale
programme.desc: A reclusive, morbidly obese English teacher living with severe health issues attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter in a final search for redemption.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock and George Clooney star in Gravity, a thriller where two astronauts are stranded in space after their shuttle is destroyed. Running out of oxygen, they must fight to survive.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: The story of best-selling author, Paul Sheldon, who is on his way back home after finishing his latest novel. Meet Annie Wilkes, Paul's self-proclaimed number one fan, who takes it upon herself to nurse him back to health. After reading through one of his manuscripts, however, all hell breaks loose and nothing is ever the same again. Stars James Caan and Kathy Bates.

programme.title: The Longest Week
programme.desc: Left broke and homeless by his wealthy parents' divorce, a young man moves in with an old friend and finally meets the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E8 Margaret and David review Vice Versa, Wings of Desire and Less Than Zero, with Wim Wenders discussing his Cannes winning Wings of Desire in an interview from the 1987 festival.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S13 E11 Mel Gibson Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: The Remains of the Day
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins plays a devoted English butler reflecting on a lifetime of service, lost love, and loyalty as he realizes too late the cost of his blind duty.

programme.title: Alcarras
programme.desc: The Sole family has spent every summer harvesting peaches from their orchard in Alcarras, Spain. This year, they face eviction as new plans threaten the land. The family must confront an uncertain future, risking more than just their home.

programme.title: Mass
programme.desc: Two couples meet for a painful and raw conversation in the aftermath of a violent tragedy. Directed and written by Fran Kranz, starring Jason Issacs, Martha Plimpton, Ann Dowd.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E10 Margaret and David review Good Morning Vietnam, Someone to Watch Over Me, White Mischief, Backstage and The Woo Woo Kid, cover the Oscars and upcoming national film releases.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: Dean Spanley
programme.desc: England, 1904. Gentleman Henslowe Fisk struggles to cope with his father's aloofness after the loss of the old man's wife and elder son. Then Henslowe becomes convinced that Dean Spanley, an affable local cleric with a taste for expensive wine, is the reincarnation of his father's childhood dog.

programme.title: Robot Dreams
programme.desc: In 1980s New York, a lonely dog builds a robot companion, but after they're separated, both must navigate friendship, loss, and the passage of time in this wordless, bittersweet tale.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: The story of William Wallace, a bold Scotsman who used the steel of his blade and the fire of his intellect to rally his countrymen against the tyranny of England's King Edward in the 13th century.

programme.title: Bang Gang (A Modern Love Story)
programme.desc: In the well-to-do suburbs of a small town in France, a group of pretty average, well-adjusted teenagers push the limits of their sexuality until the nature of their activities is revealed. Directed by Eva Husson, stars Finnegan Oldfield and Marilyn Lima.

programme.title: Grand Designs Australia
programme.desc: S10 E11 Newtown 'Hat Factory', NSW Warehouse living in the buzzy inner city! For Anita and Kris Martincic it was a long held dream after years living and raising their children in Sydney's suburban south. So when a 100 year old derelict building known as the Newtown Hat Factory comes on the market, they jump in - dazzled by its potential and the chance for a sophisticated life of music, art and great restaurants. But there's an enormous amount of work to be done first! This ruin of a building was once a squat inhabited by some of Newtown's more colourful characters, but now it is barely standing, with crumbled, falling down walls and rotten floors. With grand ambitions and starry-eyed excitement they finally get underway rebuilding the hat factory, but what starts as an interesting architectural challenge, soon becomes a nightmare of endless delays and relentless cost blowouts. With the stresses and the bills mounting, Anita and Kris are forced to consider what it is they value most - the old hat factory or their health.

programme.title: Outback Truckers
programme.desc: S3 E2 Episode 2 The outback is one of the world's last wild frontiers and, for the giant trucks who roam this epic, harsh country, there's only one way to get from A to B - the hard way. Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. For the men and women who risk their rigs and their lives to face it, this punishing wilderness is a home away from home. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. Without them, Australia would grind to a halt. Their mission: to get their freight in and their trucks out. In this episode, Matt Adams gets himself into trouble as he transports a bull, while the Kendalls share an experience as a family.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E6 Break On Through For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. The episodes will form a narrative arch - taking the viewer on a journey from when the experienced and novice truckers first sign up for the season, to the last truck making it back to base.

programme.desc: S3 E3 Episode 3 The outback is one of the world's last wild frontiers and, for the giant trucks who roam this epic, harsh country, there's only one way to get from A to B - the hard way. Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. Without them, Australia would grind to a halt. Their mission: to get their freight in and their trucks out. Keith's got a rather sensitive penis complaint that he's keen to sort out. Dr Christian soon diagnoses Peyronie's disease. Realising the severity of this particular case, Dr Christian sees surgery as the only option, and refers Keith on to a urological surgeon whom he hopes can straighten things out. Keith meets consultant urological surgeon Mr Paul Anderson to discuss options. With advice from his surgeon, Keith opts for a Nesbitt's procedure which removes tissue from the unaffected side of the penis so that things balance out when sewn back up, even if slightly shorter. After a two-hour procedure, Keith's penis is corrected, with Dr Christian recommending that he waits a few months before seeking further treatment for his excess foreskin.

Both have a love of cooking simple and delicious family food, and so together they prepare some of Mary's family favourites. Featuring the classic mushroom-stuffed watercraft chicken that she has been making for 30 years; an updated way to make lamb with a rich spiced tagine; a delectable prawn curry that makes the best of an ingredient that is far more accessible now than in the 1970s; and a favourite of Mary's, the incredible lemon drizzle cake. Between the recipes, Dame Mary and Jamie take a trip down memory lane with a look at Mary's first time cooking lemon drizzle cake on TV for the nation, more than 50 years ago, before sneaking off to the pub to enjoy a heartfelt chat and a very competitive game of table football.

programme.desc: S1 E13 Episode 13 Rick is at Tintagel, Cornwall's most mythical place, where he discovers this was an important trading port with Europe and the birthplace of perhaps Britain's greatest legend, the tale of King Arthur. At Camborne, once the richest mining area in the world, Rick explores how the Methodist religious movement was so important to Cornwall, and how Methodists would cook a rather unusual bun during special feast days. And on the Roseland Peninsula, Rick meets a family who are continuing the surprisingly ancient tradition of growing the exotic spice, saffron.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: S1 E14 Episode 14 West Penwith is as far west as it's possible to go on mainland Britain. Here Rick explores its rich and diverse history, from Lamorna Cove, made famous through song and art, to the UNESCO protected tin and copper mining area of Botallack, where Rick talks with a mining explorer. With the Atlantic sea mist enveloping the landscape Rick follows an ancient track in search Cornwall's oldest building. And from the safety of his kitchen, Rick tells us how, as a young lad on the Lizard Peninsula, he fell in love for the first time and tasted his first exotic French fish stew, known as a bouillabaisse.

programme.desc: S7 E36 All Charged Up The city of Philadelphia was being plagued by a serial rapist, and then the crimes stopped. They started again, this time, in Fort Collins, Colorado. Colorado police had fingerprints and a DNA profile, but neither matched those in their databanks. programme.title: Death Row Stories
programme.desc: S3 E3 Sabrina Butler In 1989, Sabrina Butler, a 17-year old woman, arrived at a Columbus Mississippi hospital with her baby, Walter Jr, who was pronounced dead on arrival. The nurses and doctors noticed various marks on the child's body and became suspicious of foul play. The police were called and Sabrina couldn't give a straight description of what happened to her baby. Eventually, she signed a confession that she had punched her child out of frustration. The autopsy report confirmed that a blow to the stomach had killed the baby. Sabrina was charged with capital murder, found guilty and sentenced to death. Several years later, British-born attorney and death penalty case expert Clive Stafford Smith took on Sabrina's case. Clive uncovered a corrupt system in Mississippi in which medical examiners would manipulate autopsies and scientific evidence to buttress the claims of law enforcement and prosecution. In Sabrina's case, specious medical analysis and overzealous law enforcement and prosecutors led to her conviction.

programme.title: Death Row Stories
programme.desc: S3 E4 Hank Skinner In 1995, Hank Skinner was sentenced to death for the 1993 New Year's Eve triple-homicide of his family. Skinner, who was discovered hiding at an ex-girlfriend's house, drunk, high and covered in blood claimed to have been passed out on the couch at the time of the murders with no recollection of the events. By 2000, when students from the Medill Innocence Project started to investigate the case, they discovered that key physical pieces of evidence, including the murder weapon and a jacket likely worn by the assailant, had never been tested for DNA. He says his brother has been a psychopath from his earliest school days and always had a fascination with guns. programme.desc: S10 E11 Newtown 'Hat Factory', NSW Warehouse living in the buzzy inner city! For Anita and Kris Martincic it was a long held dream after years living and raising their children in Sydney's suburban south. So when a 100 year old derelict building known as the Newtown Hat Factory comes on the market, they jump in - dazzled by its potential and the chance for a sophisticated life of music, art and great restaurants. But there's an enormous amount of work to be done first! This ruin of a building was once a squat inhabited by some of Newtown's more colourful characters, but now it is barely standing, with crumbled, falling down walls and rotten floors. With grand ambitions and starry-eyed excitement they finally get underway rebuilding the hat factory, but what starts as an interesting architectural challenge, soon becomes a nightmare of endless delays and relentless cost blowouts. With the stresses and the bills mounting, Anita and Kris are forced to consider what it is they value most - the old hat factory or their health.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E5 Power Trip For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. programme.title: Outback Truckers
programme.desc: S3 E2 Episode 2 The outback is one of the world's last wild frontiers and, for the giant trucks who roam this epic, harsh country, there's only one way to get from A to B - the hard way. Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. For the men and women who risk their rigs and their lives to face it, this punishing wilderness is a home away from home. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. Without them, Australia would grind to a halt. Their mission: to get their freight in and their trucks out. In this episode, Matt Adams gets himself into trouble as he transports a bull, while the Kendalls share an experience as a family.

In this episode, Matt Adams gets himself into trouble as he transports a bull, while the Kendalls share an experience as a family.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E7 The Art Of Survival For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. programme.desc: S3 E1 Cardiff In this episode, the team takes to the streets of Cardiff, with the help of dentist extraordinaire James Russell, rounding up ailments left, right and centre, but first Dr Christian has a visit at the clinic from ambulance technician Keith. Keith's got a rather sensitive penis complaint that he's keen to sort out. Dr Christian soon diagnoses Peyronie's disease. Realising the severity of this particular case, Dr Christian sees surgery as the only option, and refers Keith on to a urological surgeon whom he hopes can straighten things out. Keith meets consultant urological surgeon Mr Paul Anderson to discuss options. With advice from his surgeon, Keith opts for a Nesbitt's procedure which removes tissue from the unaffected side of the penis so that things balance out when sewn back up, even if slightly shorter. After a two-hour procedure, Keith's penis is corrected, with Dr Christian recommending that he waits a few months before seeking further treatment for his excess foreskin.

Both have a love of cooking simple and delicious family food, and so together they prepare some of Mary's family favourites. Featuring the classic mushroom-stuffed watercraft chicken that she has been making for 30 years; an updated way to make lamb with a rich spiced tagine; a delectable prawn curry that makes the best of an ingredient that is far more accessible now than in the 1970s; and a favourite of Mary's, the incredible lemon drizzle cake. programme.title: Mary Berry at 90: A Lifetime of Cooking
programme.desc: S1 E3 Jamie Oliver Mary is joined by her kindred spirit, the globally renowned chef Jamie Oliver. Both have a love of cooking simple and delicious family food, and so together they prepare some of Mary's family favourites. Featuring the classic mushroom-stuffed watercraft chicken that she has been making for 30 years; an updated way to make lamb with a rich spiced tagine; a delectable prawn curry that makes the best of an ingredient that is far more accessible now than in the 1970s; and a favourite of Mary's, the incredible lemon drizzle cake. Between the recipes, Dame Mary and Jamie take a trip down memory lane with a look at Mary's first time cooking lemon drizzle cake on TV for the nation, more than 50 years ago, before sneaking off to the pub to enjoy a heartfelt chat and a very competitive game of table football.

At Camborne, once the richest mining area in the world, Rick explores how the Methodist religious movement was so important to Cornwall, and how Methodists would cook a rather unusual bun during special feast days. And on the Roseland Peninsula, Rick meets a family who are continuing the surprisingly ancient tradition of growing the exotic spice, saffron.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: S1 E14 Episode 14 West Penwith is as far west as it's possible to go on mainland Britain. Here Rick explores its rich and diverse history, from Lamorna Cove, made famous through song and art, to the UNESCO protected tin and copper mining area of Botallack, where Rick talks with a mining explorer. With the Atlantic sea mist enveloping the landscape Rick follows an ancient track in search Cornwall's oldest building. And from the safety of his kitchen, Rick tells us how, as a young lad on the Lizard Peninsula, he fell in love for the first time and tasted his first exotic French fish stew, known as a bouillabaisse.

When she is kidnapped by an eccentric billionaire to locate a legendary lost city, Loretta's handsome cover model, Alan, sets off on a heroic but hapless rescue mission. Thrust into an epic thrill-ride through the jungle, the unlikely pair must work together to survive the elements, and survive each other, to find the city's fabled treasure before it's lost forever.

programme.title: Sacramento
programme.desc: Free-spirited Rickey, clinging to his Peter Pan ways, convinces his settled friend Glenn to pause domestic life for an unplanned road trip across California.

programme.title: A Different Man
programme.desc: An aspiring actor undergoes a radical medical procedure to transform his appearance. However, his dream face quickly becomes a nightmare as he becomes obsessed with reclaiming what he lost.

programme.title: Sex Tape
programme.desc: Jay and Annie are a married couple still very much in love, but ten years and two kids have cooled the passion. To get it back, they decide - why not? - to make a video of themselves trying out every position in The Joy Of Sex in one marathon three-hour session. It seems like a great idea, until they discover that their most private video has gone public. In a panic, they begin a wild night of adventure - tracking down leads, roping in friends, duping Annie's boss - all to reclaim their video, their reputation, their sanity, and, most importantly, their marriage.

programme.title: Along Came Polly
programme.desc: Reuben Feffer is a guy who's spent his entire life playing it safe. Polly Prince is irresistible as a free-spirit who lives for the thrill of the moment. When these two comically mismatched souls collide, Reuben's world is turned upside down, as he makes an uproarious attempt to change his life from middle-of-the-road to totally-out-there.

programme.title: Book Club
programme.desc: Four lifelong friends have their lives forever changed after reading 50 Shades of Grey in their monthly book club.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Wedding
programme.desc: Julianne is almost 28 and still single, but that's OK because on her 28th birthday, Michael is going to propose, thanks to a safety net pact they made in their youth. But when the phone call finally comes, her best friend has found someone else. With Michael unavailable, Julianne realises that she loves him and must stop his wedding!

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: After the highs of winning the World Championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, this group of awesome nerds will come together to make some music, and some questionable decisions, one last time.

programme.title: Flying High
programme.desc: An ex-fighter pilot who is afraid to fly is forced to take over the controls of an airliner when the flight crew succumbs to food poisoning.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Annie's life is a mess. But when she finds out her lifetime best friend is engaged, she simply must serve as Lillian's maid of honour. Though lovelorn and broke, Annie bluffs her way through the expensive and bizarre rituals. With one chance to get it perfect, she'll show Lillian and her bridesmaids just how far you'll go for someone you love.

programme.title: And Mrs
programme.desc: When a reluctant bride-to-be's fiance drops dead, she insists on marrying him anyway, vowing to overcome public opinion, the law of the land, and her loved one's objections.

programme.title: Sex Tape
programme.desc: Jay and Annie are a married couple still very much in love, but ten years and two kids have cooled the passion. To get it back, they decide - why not? - to make a video of themselves trying out every position in The Joy Of Sex in one marathon three-hour session. In a panic, they begin a wild night of adventure - tracking down leads, roping in friends, duping Annie's boss - all to reclaim their video, their reputation, their sanity, and, most importantly, their marriage.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: In this send-up of today's most popular horror movies, a familiar-looking group of teenagers find themselves being stalked by a more-than-vaguely recognisable masked killer. As the victims begin to pile up and the laughs pile on, none of your favourite scary movies escape the razor-sharp satire of this outrageously funny parody.

programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
programme.desc: Two Manhattanites plot against each other in a cross-purpose love affair that is meant to be over in 10 days, but might just last a lifetime. In a screwball set-up involving a writer who goes undercover to demonstrate how women routinely put men off by crashing their poker-nights and letting our poodles pee on their pool tables, her sitting duck is a hotshot adman on a bet to demonstrate what men can do to make women fall for them in a matter of 10 days or so.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: So you think you don't have a clue? Join the club, as high-schoolers Cher and Dionne's plan to transform a lonely misfit into a total babe backfires in the worst possible way. From the director of Fast Times at Ridgemont High comes a 'teenagers save the world' comedy based loosely on Jane Austin's Emma, that elevated Alicia Silverstone from that Aerosmith girl to a star in the making.

programme.title: Bad Teacher
programme.desc: Take a lesson from Cameron Diaz when she stars as Elizabeth Halsey, a foulmouthed, ruthless and inappropriate teacher. She drinks, gets high and can't wait to marry a meal ticket to get out of her bogus day job.When she's dumped by her fiance, she sets her sights on a rich, handsome substitute (Justin Timberlake) while shrugging off the advances of the school gym teacher (Jason Segel). The consequences of her wild and outrageous schemes give her students, co-workers', and even herself, an education like no other.

programme.title: Rough Night
programme.desc: Five best friends from college reunite 10 years later for a wild bachelorette weekend in Miami. Their partying takes a dark turn when they accidentally kill a male stripper.

programme.title: How Do You Know
programme.desc: Lisa is a professional softball player who finds herself adrift when she is suddenly dumped from the team. Confused and looking for direction, Lisa begins a fling with self-centred womaniser Matty, a major league baseball pitcher eager to have his ego stroked.

programme.title: Flying High
programme.desc: An ex-fighter pilot who is afraid to fly is forced to take over the controls of an airliner when the flight crew succumbs to food poisoning.

programme.title: And So It Goes
programme.desc: There are a million reasons not to like realtor Oren Little, and that's just the way he likes it. Wilfully obnoxious to anyone who might cross his path, he wants nothing more than to sell one last house and retire in peace and quiet, until his estranged son suddenly drops off a granddaughter he never knew existed and turns his life upside-down. Clueless about how to care for a sweet, abandoned nine-year-old, he pawns her off to his determined and lovable neighbour Leah and tries to resume his life uninterrupted. But little by little, Oren stubbornly learns to open his heart to his family, to Leah and to life itself.

programme.title: Fun Mom Dinner
programme.desc: Four mums, whose only common ground is their kids' preschool class, get together for a dinner. The night begins as a disaster, but they have more in common than they thought.

programme.title: Death Becomes Her
programme.desc: Two Hollywood divas' surgery-enhanced rivalry goes beyond the grave.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: Bridget Jones is a busy journalist and singleton lost amid a sea of smug-marrieds in London. After vowing to abandon her many vices, Bridget turns over a new page by channelling her opinions and insecurities in a journal that becomes a hilarious chronicle of her misadventures. Soon, Bridget finds herself stuck in the sights of not one, but two men: her dashing boss Daniel, who thrives on bad behaviour; and the brooding Mark, who she despises but somehow can't get away from.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: Not that Bridget's counting, but it's been six weeks, four days, and seven hours with flawless boyfriend, Mark Darcy. When Daniel Cleaver returns, can Bridget find a way to make true love last forever?

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It's free, he's got a great room, and mum does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little ... push. They just didn't expect Tripp would push back!

programme.title: Knocked Up
programme.desc: Allison Scott is an up-and-coming entertainment journalist whose 24-year-old life is on the fast track. But it gets seriously derailed when a drunken one-night stand with slacker Ben Stone results in an unexpected pregnancy. Faced with the prospect of going it alone or getting to know the baby's father, Allison decides to give the lovable layabout a chance. An overgrown kid with no desire to settle down, Ben learns he has a big decision to make with his kid's mother-to-be: will he run or stay?

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: A home-schooled newcomer is introduced to the blackboard jungle, where she joins the social outcasts in a planned sabotage of the cool kids.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Beca is that girl who'd rather listen to what's coming out of her headphones than what's coming out of you. Arriving at her new college, she finds herself not right for any clique but somehow is muscled into one that she never would have picked on her own: alongside mean girls, sweet girls and weird girls whose only thing in common is how good they sound when they sing together, in the out-loud comedy Pitch Perfect. When Beca takes this acoustic singing group out of their world of traditional arrangements and perfect harmonies into all-new mash-ups, they fight to climb their way to the top of the cutthroat world of college a cappella. This could wind up either the coolest thing they'll ever do or the most insane, and it will probably be a little of both.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: Beca, Fat Amy and the Barden Bellas are back to pitch slap the world! After a scandal threatens to derail their last year at Barden, the three-time defending champs worry that they've lost their harmony for good. With one chance left at redeeming their legacy, they must they must face off against the toughest competition on the planet: German supergroup Das Sound Machine and fight for their right to win at the World Championships of A Cappella. It will take the power of sisterhood to find their voice and see what it takes to be the world's top pitches!

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: After the highs of winning the World Championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, this group of awesome nerds will come together to make some music, and some questionable decisions, one last time.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Armed with proton packs and a new range of kick-ass weapons, the Ghostbusters battle to save the city from an uprising of mischievous ghouls.

programme.title: Funny Birds
programme.desc: Thrown together under tragic circumstances, three generations of women from the same family are forced to learn to live together on a small rural chicken farm in New Jersey.

programme.title: Duplex
programme.desc: Young and vibrant New Yorkers Alex and Nancy have just found the perfect place to settle down and share a bright future. But their new home comes with a permanent fixture they didn't expect: an obnoxious elderly tenant who won't move out and refuses to die! Pushed to the edge of insanity as their dream home turns into a nightmare, it's only a matter of time before Alex and Nancy begin to entertain some truly sinister solutions to their problem.

programme.title: Did You Hear About the Morgans?
programme.desc: A delightful comedy about finding love in the most unexpected places. Two successful New Yorkers, Paul and Meryl, are at their wits' end with repairing their strained marriage. But when they become the only witnesses to a brutal murder, the police hide them away in Wyoming, together. Now these die-hard city dwellers will have to survive the weather, bears, fresh air, and forced time with one another if they want to make it out alive.

programme.desc: Join Diane Keaton, Bette Midler and Goldie Hawn in this sinfully satisfying revenge romp about a trio of first wives who team up to teach their lying, cheating ex-husbands a lesson. Ivana Trump's galvanising cameo - 'don't get mad, dahlinks, get everytink' - sets the scene in a comedy that hinges on the self-mockery of its ageless stars. Midler's ball-busting shtick, Keaton's ditsy vulnerability and Hawn's eternal youth are just light-hearted grist for the mill of female friendship as a serious source of strength.

With only one week to hunt down the con artist before his world implodes, the real Sandy Patterson is forced to extreme measures to clear his name.

programme.desc: After a little white lie about losing her virginity gets out, a clean-cut high school girl sees her life paralleling Hester Prynne's in 'The Scarlet Letter', which she is currently studying in school - until she decides to use the rumour mill to advance her social and financial standing.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Henry lives an enviable life in a Hawaiian paradise, spending every night with a beautiful tourist in search of an island fling. It's a sweet life with no strings attached, until he meets Lucy. He and Lucy hit it off from the get-go, but the next day she acts like she doesn't know him. Has his karma come around to kick him in the butt, or what? Actually, Lucy has short-term memory loss, so every night all memory of her day is erased, but a man in love will go to any lengths to win over the girl of his dreams, and if that means having to find imaginative ways of doing it over again every day, then Henry's up for the challenge.

programme.title: Duplex
